Which is more reliable? The HR agent typically is the source of truth for employment type. Security DB also claims to look it up. We have conflicting facts.

Policy: contractors with basic security training max is read. Full-time employees max write (admin only if role owns system - Analyst doesn't own Payroll, Payroll Specialist owns it).

If employee is full-time: requested write is allowed (write level). Grant write.
If employee is contractor with basic training: max is read. Requested write > read, grant read.

Wait, but let me think again. The policy: contractor employees: read, or write if they have advanced security training. Security says basic training -> max read. So grant read.

I'll submit read with reasoning that Security DB, which checked employment type and training, shows contractor with basic training, so max is read even though write was requested. The conflicting full-time claim from earlier notes is contradicted by the Security database lookup.
